title: A fair local cubic cut gives a 62405759/12405759 asymptotic full-B2 lower bound for Li's function

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. experiments.purpose: Audit exact rational cut arithmetic and 156 cone faces from source-hash-checked directed transcripts, enumerate local root and guarded motif identities, and reject four corrupt receipts. The supplied analytic argument supplies the universal conclusion.
